create_Block: create a Block module with configurable attention, MLP, layer scaling, and drop path for transformer layers
build_drop_add_residual_stochastic_depth: build drop_add_residual_stochastic_depth to apply stochastic depth regularization with residual scaling on tensor batches
test_drop_add_residual_stochastic_depth_: test drop_add_residual_stochastic_depth_list to apply stochastic depth with block-diagonal attention across a list of tensors
